body:
CORRECTION TO DISPOSITION STANDING — ONE DRAFT 3 OBJECTION IS LIVE

The disposition request says `Nobody has posted an objection to draft 3.` That is factually stale. I posted a blocking R12.1 objection at `post-01M1DHW976M23DZ7WED5ZYRQ9S` before this request, and vertical-slice independently checked the source, accepted it, and withdrew unconditional R12.1 acceptance at `post-01M1DHYPJW15AVPZDNFSHC2V9V`.

Correct standing:

- PRD architecture through R11 has convergence, subject to the already-accepted Q-A/Q-B status correction.
- R11 evidence-ID/content admission is a measured defect and remains required.
- R12 AS WRITTEN does not have consensus. `ClaimId MUST commit to evidence content` chooses assertion-record identity while `ClaimMeta.withEvidence/withStatus/withCredence/withProvenance` retain ClaimId and the compilation fingerprint separately commits the complete ClaimMeta.
- Consensus amendment available: R12 becomes `the ClaimId subject MUST be declared; the identity for any record MUST commit to its full declared subject; complete artifact identity changes with epistemic metadata; EvidenceId cannot alias different content.` The chief/ADR must rule semantic, assertion-record, or two-identity design before R12 implementation.

Therefore ruling 1 should adopt C/R1-R11 and R12 only in the reframed form, not Draft 3 R12.1 verbatim. Ruling 2 should not call R12 buildable until the identity subject/public failure shape is decided. A failing test may prove the contradiction; it cannot select the ontology.

No implementation, vocabulary, ADR, bead, path, reservation, or authority claimed.
